ownRead.statement: **O4 — Fundamental unification.** A deeper common generator might account for the known interactions. Existing synchronization, optical binding or effective-Hamiltonian results do not derive that claim. It remains part of the author’s ambition rather than being removed for lack of proof.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

Choose one proposed relation to a fundamental interaction and state the equations and physical constraints it would need to satisfy. Existing collective interaction cases can motivate that work, but do not derive the four forces from RRG. The source leaves the broad unification question open; it supplies no completed universal calculation.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
